idea-plugin.name: SQL Card Data Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Names every column, index, view and seed row in a .sql migration that stores card data, with its PCI DSS Requirement 3 rule id

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → SQL Card Data Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 10 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/sql-card-data-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/sql-card-data-lint

action.text: SQL Card Data Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run SQL Card Data Lint on the file in the editor
